output.notes: I describe RoFormer as BERT (bert-base-uncased) with its absolute position encoding replaced by RoPE. This is the English MLM pre-training model, also fine-tuned on GLUE. The paper states only the RoPE details and the 512 max length. All other values are inherited from bert-base-uncased through the sentences saying RoFormer replaces BERT's position encoding. Inherited BERT-only parts not modelled: segment (token-type) embeddings and the BERT pooler. The paper wrongly calls BERT's position encoding sinusoidal; BERT's is learned, but it is replaced by RoPE either way. The Chinese RoFormer (built on WoBERT, used for the CAIL2019 long-text results and the HF release) has the same structure, but its vocab is not stated. Conflict: theta_i is given as 10000^{-2(i-1)/d} in Sec. 3.2.2 and as 10000^{-2i/d} in Sec. 3.3; base 10000 either way. rope_fraction is left not_stated, though the rotation matrix covers all d dims (full rotation). The MT encoder-decoder and Performer linear-attention experiments are side experiments and are not described.
